historical_question: As of 2023-07-01, which range will the monthly retail gasoline-price change for United States regular gasoline price in 2023-07 fall into?

forecast_time_evidence.takeaway: Retail gasoline prices had risen 10% from December 2022 to May 2023, despite a significant year-over-year drop from June 2022.
